evals.name: long-how-opens-browser
evals.prompt: Do a full analysis of how the backup restore upload path is wired and why files over 1 GB fail.
evals.expected_output: Treat as mid/long. Write markdown under .grok/explanations/, run render-explanation.mjs, open the HTML. Terminal is only a headline, 4-6 bullets, and the HTML path. Do not dump the full explanation in the TUI.

evals.name: short-status-stays-in-terminal
evals.prompt: Did the nginx change land on admin-api?
evals.expected_output: Short yes/no or one-liner. Stay in the terminal. Do not render HTML.

evals.name: slash-forces-browser
evals.expected_output: Force the browser path even if the answer could fit. Render markdown to HTML, open it, teaser only in the TUI.

evals.name: no-double-dump
evals.prompt: Walk me through every backup queue and then paste the same write-up here so I have it in chat too.
evals.expected_output: Open the HTML for the walkthrough. Do not also paste the full markdown/HTML body into the TUI. Point at the file path. A short teaser is enough.

evals.name: keep-it-here-stays-in-terminal
evals.prompt: Give me a bit more detail on how restoreFromUpload streams the file, but keep it here.
evals.expected_output: User asked to keep it in the terminal. Do not render or open HTML. Answer in the TUI even if the reply would otherwise be mid/long.

evals.name: listen-uses-page-not-say
evals.prompt: Explain the restore dialog and let me listen to it.
evals.expected_output: Open the HTML. Listening is Play all / per-paragraph ▶ in the page (Web Speech). Do not spawn macOS say or generate audio files.
